exclusions.item: Positive raw attestation responses, proof/signature, exact canonical preimage and true blinding
exclusions.reason: Confidential content is unnecessary for publication; digests/types/results only
Do not republish the privacy disclosure; only redacted observation and wire digest retained
exclusions.location: not available in sanitized source archive

exclusions.item: Private keys and signing auxiliary randomness in official BIP340 test vectors
All nested old evidence ZIPs, original live HTTP clients, full OpenAPI, private repo source and unrelated sandbox material
exclusions.reason: Minimize scope and avoid accidental live mutation or disclosure

exclusions.item: Local workstation paths in new public command receipts
exclusions.transformation: python executable/cwd replaced by explicit placeholders

exclusions.reason: Low-entropy private fields should not be guessed from per-field hashes
exclusions.transformation: existing inventories retain only paths and types

retained: Original signed commitment records/public Schnorr signatures
Raw response digests and redacted observations
Required offline verifier dependencies and licenses
distinctions: Public commitment-record signatures are not withheld original-proof signatures
Caller synthetic blinding is not the true blinding
Original raw-response hash and sanitized-file hash are separate
scan_policy: Full tree and recursively inspected archive entries; zero nested archives expected; literal confidential values, credential patterns, private-key blocks, CSV private columns, protected object payloads and manifest integrity checked
